categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: biomass resource regeneration and synthetic biology manufacturing. Biomass resource regeneration involves the treatment and resource utilization of organic waste such as catering waste, kitchen waste, animal solid waste, and municipal solid waste, producing biodiesel, green electricity, and biogas. The synthetic biology segment focuses on the research, development, and production of human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) and other bioactive compounds for health-related applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes microbial fermentation technology, bio-enzymatic methods, gene editing, and metabolic pathway regulation for biomass waste treatment and HMO biosynthesis. It employs advanced platforms including AI plus bioinformatics, high-throughput microfluidic screening, molecular biology, fermentation, and detection platforms. The biomass treatment process includes separate pretreatment, combined anaerobic digestion, and resource utilization, while biodiesel production uses LBD bio-enzymatic methods with mild reaction conditions and high yield.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government entities and large environmental investment enterprises involved in waste management and environmental protection. The company serves municipal solid waste treatment markets, especially in first-tier cities and core economic zones in China, and exports biodiesel products to international markets including Europe, Southeast Asia, Japan, and the US. The synthetic biology products target infant formula manufacturers, health supplement producers, and functional food companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, focusing on major economic regions such as the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, and Yangtze River Delta. It has projects in first-tier cities including Beijing, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and other provincial capitals. Internationally, it exports biodiesel to Europe and markets in Southeast Asia, Japan, and the US, and has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biomass and synthetic biology supply chains. It manages the collection, treatment, and resource conversion of biomass waste and produces bioenergy products. In synthetic biology, it develops and manufactures bioactive ingredients such as HMOs, supplying to downstream food and health product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding biomass resource regeneration projects, advancing synthetic biology manufacturing capabilities, and developing new health-related bio-products. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on gene editing, microbial strain optimization, and fermentation process improvements. It collaborates with leading research institutes to build an innovation ecosystem integrating basic research, technology development, and industrial application, aiming to lead in HMOs production and carbon reduction technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams: operating service fees from biomass waste treatment projects under BOT/BOO models, sales of resource products such as biodiesel, green electricity, and biogas, and engineering construction services via EPC contracts. Synthetic biology revenue comes from sales of HMOs and related bioactive compounds to infant formula and health product manufacturers. The company also benefits from government subsidies and carbon credit trading.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's biomass resource regeneration industry, holding the largest market share in first-tier cities for organic waste treatment. It competes with other environmental technology firms in waste treatment and bioenergy production. In synthetic biology, it is among the first domestic companies to scale up HMO production, positioning itself as a pioneer in this emerging sector. Its strong project portfolio and technological capabilities create barriers for new entrants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.79 billion, a 2.18% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising 20.51% to RMB 215.54 million. Total assets stood at about RMB 5.94 billion, with equity of RMB 3.57 billion. The company has shown steady growth in operating cash flow and continues to invest in expanding its project base and R&D capabilities, indicating a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated biomass resource regeneration model combining advanced microbial and enzymatic technologies for efficient waste treatment and resource recovery. Its synthetic biology segment leverages cutting-edge gene editing and fermentation platforms to produce high-purity HMOs, meeting stringent regulatory approvals domestically and internationally. The long-term BOT/BOO project contracts provide stable cash flows and competitive advantages in market presence, while its commitment to green and sustainable technologies aligns with national environmental policies.
